vlm.face_critique: Basic facial features and glasses are present, but hair style completely deviates from the concept updo to loose wavy hair.
vlm.secondary_critique: Scepter and crown are overly simplified, and base nameplate text is illegible.
vlm.back_critique: Volume is structurally coherent, but hair silhouette contradicts the 2D concept's braided bun.
structural_flaws: Hairstyle switched from an updo bun to loose hair
Crown and scepter geometry lacks proper form definition
aesthetic_flaws: Loss of crisp gold embroidery details
Muddy material definition on metallic elements
